name: CanhGiacSo Content Architecture

sourceOfTruth.policy: Source content may be authored in application/static content sources. Generated docs/ is never a source of truth.

phases.description: Generate canonical SEO and organic content.
Apply deterministic internal-link, SERP and trust architecture.
Compile authority, intent, CTR and content-growth waves.
Remove explicitly retired pages and their internal references before sitemap generation.
Derive canonical index inventory and sitemap from final compiled artifacts.
Attach first-party analytics and GA4 after content is final.

invariants: No stage may write outside app/, public/, github-pages/ or docs/.
docs/ is generated and must never be manually authored.
SEO audit runs only after compilation and Vite build.
Production analytics instrumentation runs after content normalization.
Legacy build transforms must be retired once their output is canonical in source or the finalizer.
